title: Chicago-area transit agencies start operating under new regional authority
summary: The state restructured the six-county Northern Illinois transit system last year and provided $1.5 billion for transportation and transit-oriented development.

title: Water cybersecurity gets federal boost in 10 cities and Texas
summary: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency is putting nearly $12 million behind water-system cybersecurity and resilience as the White House connects Texas utilities with free cyber defense resources.

title: Data center noise lawsuits test limits of local ordinances
summary: A low-level hum coming from a Microsoft data center that’s hard to measure is a nuisance that’s hurting property values, Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin, residents allege.

title: As transit ridership more than doubles in North Miami Beach, first- and last-mile service expands
summary: Transit provider ProKel Mobility helped the community redesign its bus routes to connect with surrounding transit networks.

title: Social housing program gets city task force sign-off in Portland, Maine
summary: The task force encouraged the city to establish pilot programs aimed at complementing the “tools that we already have” to address affordable housing, a city councilmember said.

title: Stormwater ‘sponges’ take root in Queens, New York, to curb flooding
summary: As part of its larger green infrastructure program, the city is repurposing existing hardscape to capture millions of gallons of stormwater before it overwhelms sewers.

title: DOT proposes streamlining land leases along roads, railroads for utility use
summary: Revenues from the leases could fund repairs and upgrades for roads, bridges, tunnels and railroads along the corridors, according to a U.S. Department of Transportation proposal.

title: New Mexico is short 58K homes. Streamlined permitting can help, study says.
summary: Reviewing housing projects on a case-by-case basis is slowing down production in localities, a report from the Mercatus Center at George Mason University suggests.

title: States move to rein in license plate surveillance as cities face growing scrutiny
summary: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida and South Dakota are pushing for statewide rules. The issues “are too great to be decided in isolation at the local level,” the Arizona attorney general’s office says.

title: Greyhound’s 5-year turnaround: new buses, more routes, new customers
summary: The company is part of an intercity bus revival, with better intermodal terminals in major cities and an upgraded customer experience.
